extracted.name: Gary’s Turkey Burritos
extracted.description: Easy to make, these special low-fat burritos taste awesome! You don’t eat red meat, but love burritos? Well, you can’t taste the difference here. These are medium spicy, not fire hot!
ingredient_lines: 2 (7.75 ounce) cans Mexican-style hot tomato sauce (such as El Pato®)
1 (15.25 ounce) can whole kernel corn, drained
instruction_lines: Brown ground turkey in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Stir in tomato sauce, corn, and onion. Reduce heat to medium; simmer, stirring occasionally, until liquids reduce, about 20 minutes.
Heat beans in a separate medium skillet over medium-low heat.
Heat tortillas over a gas stovetop burner for 1 to 2 minutes, flipping a few times.
Fill tortillas with beans, turkey mixture, sour cream, and cheese; serve while still warm.
